title: AAEI — AI Accountability Evidence Interchange
description: Proposed OMG standard for portable, verifiable AI accountability evidence. Defines the minimum field set required to prove that an AI system, generated platform, or automated workflow delivered what it promised — across any vendor, platform, architecture, or regeneration cycle.

role.description: Who the value contract serves. The role, persona, or organizational function responsible for the outcome.

problem_statement.description: The specific business problem being addressed. Plain language. No jargon.
examples: Manual process overhead and unmeasured AI operating cost
Legacy COBOL system contains undocumented business rules at risk of loss during migration

bau_measure.description: Baseline — the pre-solution measurement. The current state before ValueLogics or the AI system was applied. Must be expressed in the same unit as ps_measure.

ps_measure.description: Post-solution measurement. The state after ValueLogics or the AI system was applied. Same unit as bau_measure.

delta.description: Measured or projected improvement. Expressed as a percentage reduction or absolute delta. Labeled as MEASURED or ESTIMATED.

fib_id.description: Unique contract identifier. Format: fib_{org}-{hash_prefix}. Immutable once issued.

sha256_hash.description: Immutable proof anchor. SHA-256 of the full AAEI record at the time of signing. Cannot be altered retroactively.

lifecycle_mode.description: Engagement mode. saas = SaaS platform delivery. full = full enterprise engagement. agency = white-label agency delivery.

energy_proxy_pct.description: Runtime compute energy reduction expressed as a percentage. Proxy derived from latency reduction (energy ≈ power × time for CPU-bound workloads). Direct power telemetry (Intel RAPL / AWS CloudWatch) required for ISO 14064 certified carbon claim.

token_reduction_pct.description: AI token exposure reduction expressed as a percentage. Derived from LOC reduction proxy (AI agents read code surface; fewer LOC = fewer tokens per maintenance session). Direct token telemetry from AI platform API required for certified measurement.

network_reduction_pct.description: Network transfer reduction expressed as a percentage. Measured directly from before/after byte counts per request. IEA methodology: 0.06 kWh/GB. EPA eGRID: 0.386 kg CO2e/kWh.

vlh.description: Value Logic Hash — SHA-256 fingerprint of the canonical logic contract. Computed from: problem_statement + role + bau_measure + goal_measure + business_rules + workflow_definitions + api_contracts + functional_equivalence_tests + proof_requirements + evidence_requirements. NOT a hash of files. A hash of meaning. If VLH matches before and after regeneration, business logic was preserved exactly. If VLH does not match, a rule, metric, or proof requirement changed — and the system can report exactly what changed.
vlh.distinguishing_property: A normal hash proves files did not change. The VLH proves business logic, behavior, and value promise did not change — even if the generated code is completely different.

ldr_ratio.description: Logic Density Ratio — authored KV lines divided by source LOC analyzed. Measures how efficiently business logic has been compressed into a canonical representation. Lower is better. Industry baseline = 1.0 (no compression). ValueLogics target = 0.15 or below. A validated LDR report MUST include a VLH proving the extracted business intent survived compression losslessly.

source_snapshot_hash.description: SHA-256 of original source files before any ValueLogics processing. Proves provenance — what was analyzed. Computed before extract320.py or run_ai_app_refactor.py runs. This is the file hash. The VLH is the logic hash. Together they prove: (1) what was analyzed, (2) what business logic was extracted, and (3) whether that logic survived regeneration.

hash_chain.description: The complete AAEI v1.2 proof chain — from source analysis to board-ready proof

sequence.proves: what business logic was extracted (meaning continuity)

sequence.note: computed by VDSC implementation layer — not a public AAEI field
computed by VDSC implementation layer — planned for AAEI v1.3

sequence.proves: this AAEI record was not altered (record integrity)

ldr_standard.description: The LDR Standard defines what a valid LDR measurement requires
requirements: ldr_ratio must be computed from actual wc -l counts — not estimated
source_snapshot_hash must be present to prove what was counted
vlh must be present to prove lossless compression
All three fields together constitute a validated LDR report
LDR alone (without VLH) is a ratio, not a standard

interpretation.below_0.2: Elite compression — business logic fully portable
interpretation.above_0.8: Minimal compression — logic still largely implementation-bound

lifecycle_modes.saas: SaaS platform delivery — generated platform hosted and operated
lifecycle_modes.full: Full enterprise engagement — design package + compiler + runtime proof
